paite: Atawp pen in unaute aw, Toupa thu noumau lak a a-om bang in, khang a hih thupi a a-omtheihna ding leh,
heading: Thumsak Ding A Ngetna

paite: migenhakte leh migiloute lak a ka bit theihna ding un, hon thumsak un; mi tengteng in lah ginna anei vek kei uhi.
Himahleh Toupa amuanhuai a, ama'n noute hon phutkip in giloupa a pan ahon veng ding hi.
K'on thupiak peuhmah uh na hihzou ua, na hih zelzel uh leng Toupa ah ka hon gingta uhi.
Toupa'n na lungtangte uh Pathian itna ah leh Khrist kuhkalna ah pilut hen.
Huan unaute aw, koute a kipan a thuhilhna amuh bang ua om lou nasep thadah, dan lou bang a om unau tengteng a pan kihemkhe ding in i Toupa Jesu Khrist min in thu ka hon pia uhi.
heading: Thanuam Ding A Thuhilhna

paite: Na kiang ua ka om lai un, dan lou bang in ka gamta ngei kei uh chih leh noumau mahmah in na hon zuihdan ding uh na thei uhi.
Kuamah khut a kipan athawn in na tanghou uh leng ka ne ngei kei uh; noute ka hon tuailuai saklouhna ding un sun leh zan a gim leh tawltak a sem kawm in ka ne zaw zel uhi.
Huai thuneihna ka neih louh ziak uh hilou in, ka omdan uh na zuih ding ua etton ding hon pia ka hi zaw hi.
Na kiang ua ka om lai un; kuapeuh in nna asepnop keileh nek leng ne kei hen, chi in thu ka hon pia uhi.
Na lak ua khenkhat dan lou a omte tungtang ka za uhi, huaite'n nna himhim asem kei ua, midangte nasep ah akichinglah zaw uhi.
Huchi ahih chiang in, huai mite nasem hiathiat ding leh amau tanghou ne ding in Toupa Jesu Khrist ah thu pia in ka hanthawn uhi.
Unaute aw, nou zaw thil hoih hih chimtak kei un.
Huan kuapeuh in hiai ka laikhak ua ka thu uh azuih kei uleh, na kithuahpih hetlouhna ding un chiamteh un, azumtheihna ding in.
Ahi, melma bang in en kei unla, unau bang in hilh zaw un.
Tu in muanna Toupa'n kong chiteng ah noute hon khamuan tawntung hen. Toupa na vek ua lak ah om hen.
heading: Thu Nanungte

paite: Kei, Paul in, keimah khut a hiai chibai bukna ka gelh ahi; hiai ka laikhak teng ah chiamtehna ahi; hichibang ka gelhdan ahi.
I Toupa Jesu Khrist hehpihna na vek ua tung ah om hen. Amen.
